id.title: Id
id.description: A short name, unique in this file.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where it stands today. You move it along as it grows.
status.$comment: Lifecycle stage. DATA-MODEL suggests idea -> develop -> execute -> archive, but the vocabulary is instance-defined and real instances differ (Discovery/Develop in one; Develop/Execute/Integrate in another; Backlog/Planning/In Progress/Ongoing/Done/Icebox in a third). Not an enum: a hardcoded one rejected every project in every instance checked.

type.title: Kind
type.description: Its shape: a programme, a project, a workstream, an experiment.
type.$comment: Project shape. Instance-defined; DATA-MODEL suggests the examples below.

target_completion.title: Aim to finish
target_completion.description: When it should be done, if there is a date.

description.title: Summary
description.description: What it is, in a sentence or two.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.description: Steps on the way, each with a date.

related_ideas.title: Ideas
related_ideas.description: The ideas it grew from or carries forward.

funding_source.title: Funding source
funding_source.description: The funding opportunity that pays for it.

$comment: Optional fields accept null: in these YAML registries an explicitly-unset field is written as `null`, and refusing it made real entries unsavable.
